description: This file defines a generic class `ShardIdExtractor` that implements the `PubSubTopicExtractor` interface. It extracts shard IDs from messages using a provided `ShardRegionExtractor`, and provides a static factory method for instantiation.

classes.name: ShardIdExtractor
classes.description: A final class implementing `PubSubTopicExtractor` to produce shard ID topics from messages.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a `ShardIdExtractor` instance using a `ShardRegionExtractor`.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Returns a singleton collection containing the shard ID derived from the message.
